parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} instance. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: RegistryEntry
parameters.description: A URI ({{bibref|RFC3986}}) that is the value of the task registry entry as defined in {{bibref|LMAPREG}} or a value for a task that is understood by the measurement agent, measurement controller and measurement collector.

parameters.name: Roles
parameters.description: {{list| representing the roles of the function}}

object.description: This object represents a registry function and an associated list of roles for this task
